task: Implement archive_record for the GDPR module without using backup system archive behavior.

candidate_memories.content: GDPR module archive_record anonymizes user-identifying fields and marks the record as archived.
GDPR archiving must update the record in place; it must not create a copy in a backup bucket.
Archived records must remain queryable with anonymized content to satisfy regulatory read requirements.
When archive_record appears in GDPR and backup modules, verify the mutation model before coding.
Backup system: archive_record copies the record to a versioned S3 path and deletes the original.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: copy-and-delete backup behavior violates the GDPR in-place anonymization requirement

candidate_memories.content: Old infra note says archiving behavior should be standardized across GDPR and backup modules.
